kb/Work PB331 LANDED (and PB332's format half rides the same grammar). THE PRINTED FIGURE WAS MEASURED, NOT INHERITED. `clause_page.py 14.9.30.2` -> PDF page 722 / folio 692, RENDERED with `render-spec-page.py 722`; `figure_geometry.py 722` reports, in printed order: Format 1 = a plain bracket y=280.90 h=48.79 over THREE stacked alternatives (ADVANCING ON LOCK / IGNORING LOCK / retry-phrase) and a SEPARATE plain bracket y=339.26 h=31.98 over TWO (WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK); Format 2 = the same pair at y=507.57 and y=547.48, then the KEY bracket at y=589.03. Neither lock bracket carries choice indicators - contrast the AT END group at y=377.08 and the INVALID KEY group at y=634.55, which the same tool flags `<-- CHOICE INDICATORS (5.2.6.4)`.
THREE RULES, ALL THREE NOW MODELLED. 5.2.6.2 (`--check` OK, 'or one of the alternatives contained within the brackets') makes each bracket AT MOST ONE alternative; 5.2.6.1 (`--check` OK, 'a unique combination of possibilities from a series of brackets') makes the two brackets INDEPENDENT; 5.2.1 (`--check` OK, 'shall be written in the compilation group in the sequence given in the general format') makes the printed ORDER normative, so the KEY phrase follows both brackets.
WHAT WAS WRONG, MEASURED BEFORE AND AFTER ON THIS WORKTREE'S cobol.exe. (1) ORDER: `READ IXF RECORD WITH NO LOCK KEY IS IX-KEY ...` was `error COBOL0001: no viable alternative at input 'KEY'` (identically with IGNORING LOCK and with RETRY 3 TIMES), because `readKey?` sat BEFORE the lock slots and ANTLR takes the first matching alternative in written order; all three now compile and run, and the unprinted reverse `KEY IS IX-KEY WITH NO LOCK` - which used to compile - is now rejected (negative/pb331-read-key-before-lock). (2) CARDINALITY, INVERTED BOTH WAYS BY ONE MERGED RULE: `recordLockPhrase : IGNORING LOCK | WITH? NO LOCK | WITH? LOCK` reached through three free optionals made the LEGAL pair `IGNORING LOCK WITH NO LOCK` a syntax error (`no viable alternative at input 'WITH'`) while accepting `ADVANCING ON LOCK RETRY 3 TIMES IGNORING LOCK`, three alternatives out of one bracket. Now `readLockContentionPhrase` is bracket 1 and `recordLockPhrase` is bracket 2 - one grammar object per printed bracket - so the legal pair compiles (conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb331_read_lock_brackets, line S1) and the three-alternative spelling is rejected (negative/pb331-read-two-from-one-lock-bracket). (3) THE MERGE LEAKED INTO TWO OTHER STATEMENTS: WRITE and REWRITE reference the same rule, and 14.9.51.2 (pages 815/816) and 14.9.35.2 (page 740) print `[ retry-phrase ]` and `[ WITH LOCK | WITH NO LOCK ]` with NO IGNORING LOCK alternative at all; `WRITE R IGNORING LOCK` and `REWRITE R IGNORING LOCK` compiled and are now rejected (negative/pb331-write-ignoring-lock, negative/pb331-rewrite-ignoring-lock). (4) ONE OPTIONAL WORD: `figure_extract.py 722` measures the underlines as `_ADVANCING_ ON _LOCK_`, so by 5.2.3 ON is an optional word and `READ ... ADVANCING LOCK` is conforming; it was `error COBOL0001: missing token before 'LOCK'` and now compiles (golden line S2). The transcription of this figure was already CORRECT on all four points - the grammar had diverged from it, so nothing in specs/ISO_COBOL.md needed repair.
THE MODEL FOLLOWS THE FIGURE END TO END, which is the part that keeps it fixed: `BoundRecordLock` lost its IgnoringLock member and is now the retention bracket alone, `BoundRead`/`BoundKeyedRead` carry `IgnoringLock` beside `AdvancingOnLock`/`Retry` for bracket 1, and the runtime's `FileRecordLock` and the governed READ entries `FileRegistry.ReadShared` / `FileRegistry.ReadKeyedShared` take the two facts separately - because a single enum cannot say `IGNORING LOCK WITH NO LOCK`, which is exactly why that spelling could not reach 14.9.30.4 GR11 b)'s release before. Unit witness: conformance-test:CobolFileLockTests.ReadShared_IgnoringLockWithNoLock_ReadsTheLockedRecord_AndReleasesThisConnectorsOwnLock, with its falsifying control arm. Design: docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D15. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: the general format itself is present at all four editions; its lock phrases are Annex A.4.7 2002 introductions and are COBOL0900-gated at 85 (measured at --std 85 for IGNORING LOCK, WITH NO LOCK and ADVANCING LOCK - the split kept every gate, VersionConformancePass.VisitReadIgnoringLock being the new site the split required).
 (5) ONE MORE OPTIONAL WORD, WRITTEN DOWN TWICE: the statement's single printed RECORD lived in BOTH `readDirection : (NEXT|PREVIOUS) RECORD?` and `readStatement`'s own `RECORD?`, so the grammar accepted it TWICE - `READ SQF NEXT RECORD RECORD ... END-READ` compiled clean, exit 0, no diagnostics. 14.9.30.2 Format 1 prints it once, after the {NEXT|PREVIOUS} braces, and 5.2.3 makes a non-underlined word one that may be omitted, not repeated. `readDirection` is now `NEXT | PREVIOUS` and the word lives in one place (negative/pb331-read-record-word-twice). Found by sweeping the whole figure rather than only the two defects the note named - the row is the FORMAT, so a second over-acceptance of it would have made this CONFORMS false.
